title: Sauna Heater Size Table
subtitle: Heater kW for sauna rooms of 3 to 30 m3, with glass, stone and log walls
description: Electric sauna heater power in kW for every room from 3 to 30 m3 (106 to 1,059 cu ft), with 0 to 4 m2 of uninsulated glass or stone, with and without bare log walls: 280 rows, 13 columns. Each row gives the calculated volume and the kW range by Harvia's rules (1 kW per m3 high, 1 kW per 50 cu ft low, +1.2 m3 per m2 of glass or stone, log walls x 1.5) and, for comparison, HUUM's rule (+1 m3 per m2) and the North American 'Sizing Your HUUM' sheet (+4.92 cu ft per sq ft). Generated by the open-source code of the Sauna Heater Size Calculator; the README lists every source. A rule-of-thumb reference: always confirm with the heater manufacturer and a licensed electrician. Version 1.0 (2026-11). Published by DIVELUX, makers of wool sauna hats: https://diveluxsaunahat.com/pages/sauna-tools

resources.description: The table: 280 rows, 13 columns, UTF-8. Empty cells mean the rule does not apply (HUUM for log walls).
The same rows plus a column dictionary; empty cells are null.
Printable chart, US Letter, three pages.
